problems.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
problems.gist: You get an integer array nums whose values are all distinct and were sorted in ascending order. Before you see it, the array may have been rotated at an unknown pivot k: it became [nums[k], nums[k+1], ..., nums[n-1], nums[0], ..., nums[k-1]].

problems.title: Find Peak Element
problems.gist: A sensor logs a row of altitude readings nums (0-indexed). A reading is a peak if it is strictly greater than each of its neighbours.

problems.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
problems.gist: A sensor log holds n distinct integer readings that were sorted in increasing order and then rotated between 1 and n times. One rotation moves the last element to the front: [a0, a1, ..., a(n-1)] becomes [a(n-1), a0, a1, ..., a(n-2)].

problems.gist: You are given an integer array nums of non-negative weights and an integer k. Cut nums into exactly k non-empty contiguous pieces (subarrays). The cost of a cut is the largest piece sum. Return the smallest possible cost over all ways to cut.

problems.gist: You are given an integer array nums sorted in non-decreasing order. Every value occurs exactly twice, except one value that occurs exactly once. Return that single value.

problems.title: Search a 2D Matrix

gfg.why: only rows sorted; binary search each row

problems.gist: A shelf of m rows with n integer labels each is laid out so that labels grow left to right inside a row (equal neighbours allowed), and every row starts above the largest label of the row before it. Read row by row, the shelf is one long sorted list.

problems.title: Find First and Last Position of Element in Sorted Array
problems.gist: You are given an integer array nums sorted in non-decreasing order (equal values are allowed and sit next to each other) and an integer target. Return a two-element array [first, last]: the smallest and the largest index i with nums[i] == target.

problems.title: Capacity To Ship Packages Within D Days
problems.gist: Packages wait on a conveyor belt in a fixed order; weights[i] is the weight of the i-th package. A ship carries them over days days. Each day it loads packages in the given order (no skipping, no reordering), as long as the total loaded that day does not exceed its capacity.

problems.title: Time Based Key-Value Store
problems.gist: Design a key-value store that keeps several values per key, each tagged with the time it was written, and can answer "what was the value of this key at time t?". Implement class TimeMap:

problems.title: Sqrt(x)
problems.gist: You are given a non-negative integer x (a tile count). Return the integer square root of x: the largest integer r with r · r <= x, which is the square root rounded down. The returned value must be a non-negative integer.
